findings.evidence: NEVER type a handler with `any` or read `e.target.value as string`: `target` can be a descendant element and `any` hides it. Use `ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>` and `e.currentTarget`, and `new FormData(e.currentTarget)` on submit.
findings.fix: Shorten this to one activation clause ('handlers: ChangeEvent<El> plus e.currentTarget, never e.target as string'). The model already knows target vs currentTarget and the ChangeEvent types, so the saved lines can go to non-obvious traps such as the submitter and IME cases.

findings.evidence: Before writing a generic API, ask: which two positions must agree ... — the only explicit 'before X, ask' framework; the server/client rules at lines 88-90 are stated as rules with no decision question
findings.fix: Add a classification question to step 2: 'Before writing any component, ask where it runs: server render only, client only, or both (every "use client" file also renders on the server). Then apply the matching window, use() and Server Action rules.'

findings.evidence: Run `npx types-react-codemod preset-19 ./src` before fixing by hand.
findings.fix: Make this file-rewriting step exact: 'On a clean git tree, run `npx types-react-codemod@<pinned version> preset-19 ./src`, review `git diff`, then typecheck.' This pins the codemod so it behaves the same over time and makes its edits reviewable.

findings.evidence: Eight evals cover refs, forms, generics, RR v8, SSR storage and no-router. None exercises TanStack Router (Register, validateSearch, loaderDeps), use() or useOptimistic, although the step-2 table routes to those references. The assertion 'Uses React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>' also fails a correct answer that uses a named `FormEvent` import.
findings.fix: Add one TanStack Router eval with a fixture (for example a Zod 3 .default() schema that makes search required on Link) and one useOptimistic eval that asserts a rollback on failure. Reword the assertion as 'Types the submit event as FormEvent<HTMLFormElement> (React namespace or named import)'.

findings.evidence: Run the project's typecheck (`tsc --noEmit` or its script).
